pack.card.presentation.imagegen: — the Stage Director MAY generate images (each call spends your image-provider budget)
pack.card.presentation.pack_only: — stages with pack art only, never generates (the author's veto, or no subject carries a reference image)
pack.card.presets: Ships {count} prompt preset(s) — style text the keeper may fold into the room's prompt with `.preset enable <id>` (never auto-on).
pack.card.prep: Ships {count} prep script(s): planned bulk setup a keeper runs by hand through run_prep_plan — previewed whole before anything applies, never run automatically.
pack.card.rules_script: Ships rules code: this pack decides its check outcomes in sandboxed JavaScript of its own — the engine still rolls the dice and clamps what the script hands back.
pack.card.trust: contains: {skills} skill(s), {rulepacks} rulepack(s), {cards} card(s), {lorebooks} lorebook(s), {panels} UI panel(s), {assets} asset(s) ({asset_mb} MB) · hooks code: {hooks} · EJS templates: {ejs} · rules code: {rules_script}
pack.card.world_cards: Contains {count} WORLD card(s) — module machinery (hooks/variables/EJS); the keeper imports them with `.import <file> world`.
pack.install.need_yes: Not an interactive terminal: re-run with --yes to confirm installing this pack.
pack.install.packdir: cards/lorebooks/assets: {cards}/{lorebooks}/{assets} file(s) under {path} — import in-room with .import <file> / .module
pack.install.rulepacks: rulepacks: {ids} — discoverable. They do not become the room's system by themselves: create a character on that system (the pack must declare a make_char word) or name the system on import.
pack.install.presets: presets: {ids} — listed right away (.preset list); a keeper folds one in with .preset enable <id>
pack.install.prep: prep scripts: {names} — run in-room with run_prep_plan(script_ref="<packId>/<path>") during prep
pack.install.shadowed: note: '{id}' shares a built-in id; the built-in keeps winning (rename the packed one to use it).
pack.install.skills: skills: {ids} — a keeper enables one in-room with .skill enable <id>
pack.ref.failed: Could not resolve the pack ref: {error}
